title: Dr. Munni Lal v. State of U.P. & Others
coram: Satya Poot Mehrotra & Jayashree Tiwari, JJ. (delivered by Jayashree Tiwari, J.)
disposition: Writ petition allowed (demand notice quashed; objections to be filed and decided)
headnote: Clause 8.1(b)(iii) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 requires that, on suspicion of theft, the assessing officer serve the provisional assessment bill with a show-cause notice giving 15 working days to file objections and fixing a date for hearing, before making a final assessment under Section 126. A notice giving only seven days, and without fixing a hearing, does not comply. Further, a recovery demand under Section 3 of the U.P. Government Electrical Undertaking (Dues Recovery) Act, 1958 can arise only after a final order of assessment; a demand issued before final assessment is quashed.

holding_units.topic: Theft assessment — mandatory 15-working-day show-cause notice and hearing
holding_units.question: Was the provisional theft assessment valid where the show-cause notice gave only seven days and fixed no hearing?
holding_units.holding: No. Clause 8.1(b)(iii) requires a show-cause notice giving 15 working days to object and fixing a hearing date before a final assessment; a seven-day notice with no hearing date does not comply. No final order of assessment was passed, so the recovery demand was premature.
holding_units.limiting_facts: The checking report was unsigned by the consumer; the show-cause notice gave only seven days and no hearing date; a recovery demand was enclosed before any final assessment.

holding_units.code: U.P. Government Electrical Undertaking (Dues Recovery) Act, 1958
holding_units.topic: Recovery demand presupposes a final assessment
holding_units.holding: A demand under Section 3 of the 1958 Dues Recovery Act can be issued only after a final order of assessment is passed; a demand issued before final assessment is without authority and is quashed.

principle_tags.application: A final theft assessment requires the Code's mandatory 15-working-day show-cause notice and a hearing; recovery cannot precede a final assessment.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the assessment on merits
not_decided.note: Left to the objection/final-assessment process to be decided by a speaking order.
